svg.title: Graph of the entries of the map: overlaps between entries, grouped by organisation
svg.desc: Each circle is an entry of the map and links to its page; the colour is the kind of body behind it, a filled circle is a core entry and a dashed circle a context entry. Entries are in columns by kind of body; a line joins two entries when one of them lists the other as an overlap.
svg.text: Agentic standards map: overlaps between entries
